{"status":"OK","messages":[{"level":"info","content":"Created wordfreq.mjs and test/wordfreq.test.mjs"}],"files":[{"path":"wordfreq.mjs","content":"#!/usr/bin/env node\nimport { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';\nconst args = process.argv.slice(2);\nif (args.length === 0) {\n  console.error('Usage: node wordfreq.mjs <file> [--top N]');\n  process.exit(1);\n}\nlet filePath = args[0];\nlet topN = 10;\nfor (let i = 1; i < args.length; i++) {\n  if (args[i] === '--top' && i + 1 < args.length) {\n    topN = parseInt(args[i + 1], 10);\n    if (isNaN(topN) || topN <= 0) {\n      console.error('Invalid value for --top');\n      process.exit(1);\n    }\n  }\n}\nconst text = readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');\nconst words = text\n  .toLowerCase()\n  .split(/\\W+/)\n  .filter(Boolean);\nconst freq = new Map();\nfor (const w of words) {\n  freq.set(w, (freq.get(w) || 0) + 1);\n}\nconst sorted = Array.from(freq.entries()).sort((a, b) => {\n  if (b[1] !== a[1]) return b[1] - a[1];\n  return a[0].localeCompare(b[0]);\n});\nfor (const [word, count] of sorted.slice(0, topN)) {\n  console.log(`${word} ${count}`);\n}\n"},"path":"test/wordfreq.test.mjs","content":"import assert from 'node:assert';\nimport { execSync } from 'node:child_process';\nimport fs from 'node:fs';\n\nconst tmpFile = 'tmp_test.txt';\nconst content = `Hello world! Hello, universe. World? hello.`;\nfs.writeFileSync(tmpFile, content);\n\nfunction run(args) {\n  return execSync(`node wordfreq.mjs ${args.join(' ')}`, { encoding: 'utf8' });\n}\n\n// Default top 10\nlet out = run([tmpFile]);\nlet lines = out.trim().split('\\n');\nassert.strictEqual(lines[0], 'hello 3');\nassert.strictEqual(lines[1], 'world 2');\n\n// Override top N\nout = run([tmpFile, '--top', '1']);\nlines = out.trim().split('\\n');\nassert.strictEqual(lines.length, 1);\nassert.strictEqual(lines[0], 'hello 3');\n\n// Clean up\nfs.unlinkSync(tmpFile);\nconsole.log('All tests passed');\n"}],"patches":[],"scratchpad":""}
